accept.one_directory_prefix: it takes one task directory and nothing else; the secret is never taken on the
accept.secret_format_prefix: the task secret must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters — the TASK_SECRET
accept.signed: Signed: the broker has the receipt for task %s.
accept.unreachable_prefix: The broker at 127.0.0.1:%d could not be reached (%s). Signed all the same: the receipt
accept.unreachable_suffix: is at %s, and the broker collects it at its next look.
ack.ids_required: clawdline task ack: both the task id and the notice id are required
completion_notice.not_closed: clawdline %s: the completion notice %s of %s was not closed: %v
finish.already_collected: The broker had already collected it.
finish.already_in_place: result.json was already in place with these exact bytes: %s
finish.broker_unreachable_result_saved: The broker at 127.0.0.1:%d could not be asked to collect it now (%v). Nothing is lost: result.json is the completion signal, and the broker reads it at its next look.
finish.collected: The broker collected it: this task is settled on result.json.
finish.invalid_retry: Nothing was written. Correct result.json.tmp and run this again.
finish.no_collect: Not asking the broker to collect it now; it reads result.json at its next look.
finish.not_collected_prefix: The broker did not collect it now (%s). result.json is in place, and the broker reads it
finish.replace: It stays where it is. To replace it, delete %s, write result.json.tmp again and run this again.
flag.finish.no_collect: put result.json in place and do not ask the broker to collect it now
flag.finish.port: the port of the daemon that dispatched this task (default CLAWDLINE_NEXT_PORT, else 7727)
flag.land.carrier: for incorporated: the task whose verified landing carried this one
flag.land.commit: the commit on the target that carries the delivery
flag.land.target: the branch the delivery landed on
gate_evidence.accepted: gate evidence %s accepted (%d bytes, sha256 %s, replayed=%t)

gate_evidence.no_receipt: clawdline task gate-evidence: the broker returned no matching durable receipt
gate_evidence.too_large: clawdline task gate-evidence: artifact is more than %d bytes
gate_evidence.unstreamable: clawdline task gate-evidence: artifact cannot be streamed:
gate_result.invalid: clawdline task gate-result: invalid closed gate result:
gate_result.mismatched_task: clawdline task gate-result: result task_id does not match the task directory
gate_result.no_durable_ack: clawdline task gate-result: the broker did not acknowledge a durable verdict (%v). A result file in the checker task directory cannot finish this gate; restore loopback and rerun this same command.
gate_result.no_receipt: clawdline task gate-result: the broker returned no matching durable receipt
land.id_state_required: a task id and a landing state are required
land.invalid_state_prefix: %q is not a landing state: landed, incorporated, abandoned,
land.no_record: clawdline task land: the daemon answered without the landing it recorded
notice.refused: clawdline %s: the completion notice %s of %s was not closed: refused, %s: %s
show.id_required: clawdline task show: the task id is required
show.unreadable_answer: clawdline task show: the daemon's answer could not be read:
usage.accept: usage: clawdline task accept [--port n] <task dir>
usage.accept_explain_prefix: signs for a child's briefing, with the secret from
usage.ack: clawdline task ack [--port n] <task id> <notice id>
usage.ack_explain: acknowledges a completion notice by hand; rarely needed, since task show and task wait close it
usage.cancel: clawdline task cancel [--port n] [--conversation id] [--key k] --reason "…" <task id>
usage.cancel_explain_1: stops a child its root dispatched by mistake (wrong brief, wrong scope, duplicate): its tab is closed,
usage.cancel_explain_2: its claims released, and a branch with commits is kept as a pending landing; only its root Session
usage.cancel_explain_3: or the person may; the same cancel sent again answers the same success
usage.finish_explain: validates <task dir>/result.json.tmp and publishes it as result.json, then asks the broker to collect it
usage.gate_evidence: clawdline task gate-evidence --artifact id --media-type type [--port n] <task dir> <file>
usage.gate_evidence_prefix: streams one bounded verification artifact with the secret from
usage.gate_result: clawdline task gate-result [--port n] <task dir> <json file>
usage.gate_result_prefix: submits the closed verification verdict with the secret from
usage.land_explain: records a child's landing by hand, with the orchestrator token; a merge into its target records itself
usage.show_explain: one child task, compactly: state, summary, leftovers, verification, landing, checkout;
usage.show_notice: reading a finished one closes its completion notice
usage.wait_exit_1: exit 0 all succeeded, 1 one failed, 5 one was cancelled (and none failed otherwise), 3 timed out,
usage.wait_exit_2: 4 a task could not be read; 4 over 3 over 1 over 5
usage.wait_explain_1: waits until every task (--any: one) has finished, at most --timeout (default 9m, under a 10m tool call;
usage.wait_explain_2: at most 2h), then shows each finished one as task show does and closes its notice;
view.no_result: result:       none — the child wrote no result.json
view.rerun: rerun:        resolve the failure, then rerun the check named above
